nodes.label: Plugin SDK README
nodes.description: Official TypeScript SDK reference for Doer plugin authors covering worker, UI, testing, and bundler modules

nodes.label: Hello World Example Plugin
nodes.description: First-party minimal reference plugin demonstrating dashboardWidget slot and basic lifecycle hooks

nodes.label: Wiki Graph Plugin
nodes.description: Karpathy-style wiki and Graphify knowledge graph over memfs memory and gremlin outputs

nodes.label: Letta Bridge Plugin
nodes.description: Connects Doer to Letta Cloud agents with syncing, streaming chat, and memory viewer

nodes.label: Create Doer Plugin Scaffolding
nodes.description: Tool for scaffolding new Doer plugins with templates, manifest generation, and build configuration

nodes.label: Plugin Worker
nodes.description: Server-side plugin runtime entry point defined via definePlugin, handles setup lifecycle and context APIs

nodes.label: Plugin UI Layer
nodes.description: React-based client-side plugin UI using hooks like usePluginData, usePluginAction, usePluginStream

nodes.label: Plugin Manifest
nodes.description: Configuration object declaring entrypoints, capabilities, UI slots, launchers, and metadata

nodes.label: UI Slot Types
nodes.description: Mount points for plugin components: page, sidebar, settingsPage, dashboardWidget, detailTab, etc.

nodes.label: Plugin Context API
nodes.description: Worker-side APIs provided during setup: events, jobs, tools, data, actions, streams, state, agents, etc.

nodes.label: Plugin Capabilities
nodes.description: Declared permissions system for plugins covering company data, runtime, agent, and UI operations

nodes.label: Plugin Event System
nodes.description: Core domain events subscription and plugin-to-plugin event routing via ctx.events

nodes.label: Plugin Job Scheduling
nodes.description: Scheduled jobs using cron expressions with run context and handler registration

nodes.label: Plugin Lifecycle Hooks
nodes.description: Required setup and optional onHealth, onConfigChanged, onShutdown, onValidateConfig, onWebhook hooks

nodes.label: Plugin Launcher
nodes.description: Host-rendered entry points (buttons, menu items) with placement zones and render environments

nodes.label: Plugin Streaming (SSE)
nodes.description: Real-time event streaming from worker to UI using server-sent events (SSE) and usePluginStream hook

nodes.label: Agent Sessions (Two-way Chat)
nodes.description: Multi-turn conversational sessions with agents via ctx.agents.sessions with streaming callbacks

nodes.label: Plugin Testing Utilities
nodes.description: createTestHarness for unit/integration tests with in-memory host harness and event emission

nodes.label: Plugin Bundler Presets
nodes.description: createPluginBundlerPresets for esbuild/rollup configuration for worker, manifest, and UI builds

nodes.label: Hello World Minimal Plugin
nodes.description: Simplest reference plugin using dashboardWidget slot with basic lifecycle and manifest

nodes.label: Karpathy-style Wiki Graph
nodes.description: Combines LLM wiki with knowledge graph over memfs memory and gremlin outputs for documentation

nodes.label: Wiki Graph Ingest Phase
nodes.description: Walks memfs and gremlin outputs, extracts nodes/edges, caches files, generates wiki pages

nodes.label: Wiki Graph Query Phase
nodes.description: Searchable wiki browser and interactive vis.js graph with clickable nodes linking to pages

nodes.label: Wiki Graph Lint Phase
nodes.description: Scheduled job checking for orphan pages, contradictions, stale claims, and suggested questions

nodes.label: Wiki Graph Publish to Memfs
nodes.description: Approval-gated action copying wiki into Letta agent shared memory for agent access

nodes.label: Letta Bridge Connection
nodes.description: API key-based connection to Letta Cloud with test connection and auto-sync capabilities

nodes.label: Letta Agent Browser
nodes.description: UI for listing and managing Letta agents with memory viewer tab and streaming chat

nodes.label: Letta Agent Sync
nodes.description: Hourly automatic synchronization of agent mappings to Doer state

nodes.label: Plugin Scaffolding Tool
nodes.description: create-doer-plugin CLI for generating new plugins with templates and build configuration

nodes.label: Plugin Scaffold Templates
nodes.description: Three templates: default, connector, and workspace with category selection

nodes.label: Plugin Development Workflow
nodes.description: pnpm dev for watch mode, pnpm dev:ui for local preview with hot-reload, pnpm test for testing

nodes.label: Plugin Deployment Model
nodes.description: Local path for development, npm packages for production with writable filesystem and npm at runtime

nodes.label: Plugin UI No Shared Component Kit
nodes.description: Plugins build UI with plain React components and CSS, no host-provided stable component library yet

nodes.label: Plugin Local Development Path
nodes.description: Development convenience using repo-local path install, reinstall needed after pulling changes

nodes.label: Graph Edge Type: EXTRACTED
nodes.description: Edge confidence 1.0 indicating direct textual extraction from documentation

nodes.label: Graph Edge Type: INFERRED
nodes.description: Edge confidence 0.6-0.9 indicating logical inference from multiple sources
